Interesting — "nothing at 2,8". So I'm facing down at (2,8) which is empty. But I can't move there? Let me re-read the map. The map shows row 7: `#.@P....#...#` — so (2,7) is '@' (me), (3,7) is 'P'. The notice board is listed at (2,7) but the map shows me there. 

Wait — maybe the notice board is actually a separate object and I'm standing on the same tile. Let me try moving right (KeyD) more forcefully.
